long_description: Send SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS messages and manage contacts, templates, Sender Profiles, and analytics through the Sent MCP server. Specialist skills cover US A2P 10DLC registration, WhatsApp Business (WABA) templates and embedded signup, RCS agent launch, webhook receivers with signature verification, channel routing, two-way messaging, delivery diagnosis, SDK integration, and staged migration from another CPaaS provider.
default_prompts: Use $sent-integration-starter to review how this application should integrate Sent safely.
Use $sent-routing-strategist to explain the safest channel and reroute policy for this workflow.
Use $migrate-to-sent to plan a staged migration from our current messaging provider.
marketplace_description: Official Sent skills and remote MCP integration for messaging engineering, operations, migration, and specialist channel workflows.
